name: Claude Enterprise Assistant
description: Claude AI custom analytic widget with support for Hyperspace AI (SAP internal), Anthropic API, and OpenRouter free-tier models.

model.description: AI model ID. Hyperspace AI: anthropic--claude-haiku-latest / anthropic--claude-sonnet-latest / anthropic--claude-opus-latest. Anthropic direct: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. OpenRouter: anthropic/claude-3-haiku.

temperature.description: Response generation creativity metric (0.0 = precise, 1.0 = creative)

welcomeMsg.default: Welcome to Claude Assistant! Synchronize actuals data to model your insights.

apiUrl.description: Hyperspace AI (SAP internal): http://localhost:6655/anthropic/v1/messages  |  Anthropic API: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages  |  OpenRouter (free models): https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions

apiKey.description: API key. Hyperspace AI: use your Hyperspace proxy API key  |  Anthropic: console.anthropic.com  |  OpenRouter (free): openrouter.ai/keys

setTableData.description: Passes active canvas model string arrays to context memory. Enables the chat input once data is received.

setHeaderLabel.description: Dynamically sets the header layout title

onStart.description: Triggers customized event structures during boot sequences.
